title: Andhra Pradesh Coastal Thunderstorm Cluster & Sea-Breeze Convergence
synoptic_narrative: Interaction between advancing sea-breeze front and inland convective heating sparked a quasi-stationary multicell convective system parallel to the coastline. Training convective cells produced localized torrential rain and continuous lightning.
convective_features: Linear sea-breeze convergence boundary triggering repetitive cell regeneration
Quasi-stationary storm motion resulting in localized flash density hot-spots
Moderate CAPE (2200 J/kg) with high precipitable water (>55 mm)

imd_bulletin.bulletin_text: NOWCAST WARNING: Moderate thunderstorm with lightning likely over Visakhapatnam, Vizianagaram and Kakinada districts during next 3 hours.
imd_bulletin.spatial_precision: Covers 3 districts spanning 240 km of coastline without spatial gradient.

baseline_expectations.climatology_persistence: Reasonable persistence at +15m, but fails as new cells back-build along the sea breeze.
baseline_expectations.nwp_environmental_threshold: Moderate performance, but cannot pinpoint the narrow 8 km coastal convergence zone.
baseline_expectations.lagrangian_advection: Advects existing cells inland while missing newly developing upwind feeder cells.
baseline_expectations.uncalibrated_gbdt: Overconfident on mature cells, underconfident on infant convective towers.
baseline_expectations.imd_text_bulletin: Widespread false alarm across inland non-convective taluks.
baseline_expectations.vajra: Captures training cell dynamics with FSS > 0.62 at 30 km neighborhood scale.
